{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {df.duplicated('patient_id').sum()}")

# Check the distribution of arm and severity
print("\nCross-tab of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"\nNumber of patients with multiple sample_seq: {sample_seq_max[sample_seq_max > 1].count()}")"}
